parts:
Hey,

I looked into the code and in the file rdump.m, I noticed that there are only categories for scalar, vector, and matrix. Is there a possibility of adding the option for arrays? Otherwise, it's not possible to add arrays into the code. I have posted the code from rdump below.

% https://github.com/stan-dev/rstan/search?q=stan_rdump&ref=cmdform
% struct or containers.Map
function fid = rdump(fname,content)
   if isstruct(content)
      vars = fieldnames(content);
      data = struct2cell(content);
   elseif isa(content,'containers.Map')
      vars = content.keys;
      data = content.values;
   end

   fid = fopen(fname,'wt');
   for i = 1:numel(vars)
      if isscalar(data{i})
         if any(data{i}(:) > intmax('int32'))
            fprintf(fid,'%s <- %f ',vars{i},data{i});
         else
            fprintf(fid,'%s <- %d ',vars{i},data{i});
         end
      elseif isvector(data{i})
         fprintf(fid,'%s <- c(',vars{i});
         if any(data{i}(:) > intmax('int32'))
            fprintf(fid,'%f, ',data{i}(1:end-1));
            fprintf(fid,'%f) ',data{i}(end));
         else
            fprintf(fid,'%d, ',data{i}(1:end-1));
            fprintf(fid,'%d) ',data{i}(end));
         end
      elseif ismatrix(data{i})
         fprintf(fid,'%s <- structure(c(',vars{i});
         if any(data{i}(:) > intmax('int32'))
            fprintf(fid,'%f, ',data{i}(1:end-1));
            fprintf(fid,'%f), .Dim = c(',data{i}(end));
         else
            fprintf(fid,'%d, ',data{i}(1:end-1));
            fprintf(fid,'%d), .Dim = c(',data{i}(end));
         end
         fprintf(fid,'%g,',size(data{i},1));
         fprintf(fid,'%g',size(data{i},2));
         fprintf(fid,')) ');
      end
   end
   fclose(fid);
end

By array do you mean Matlab's cell array? Cell's in cell array may have different data types and different sizes, which is not supported by Stan (ragged arrays are in the todo list). I think MatlabStan should give an error if the data is no numerical scalar, vector or matrix.

Aki
